$comment: Multi-client platform configuration. The server validates this file at startup and serves the non-secret parts to the web app at GET /platform-api/config. Restart the server after editing. Secrets (SESSION_SECRET, Intuit keys) stay in environment variables.

platform.$comment: Product branding shown on the login page, sidebar and browser tab. PLATFORM_NAME env var overrides name.
platform.name: Ledgerview
platform.tagline: Financial reporting across every entity you manage

auth.$comment: demoMode seeds every sample user with demoPassword and lists demo accounts on the login page. Turn both off before real clients use it.

permissions.$comment: Every permission the server checks. Roles below grant these; navigation items require them.
permissions.entities.all: See every entity in the organization (otherwise only assigned ones)
permissions.entities.manage: Add, edit, reconnect and remove entities and groups
permissions.users.manage: Invite users, change roles and entity access

roles.$comment: platform_admin is required and applies across all organizations. Every other role is assignable inside an organization; order sets the order in pickers. adminRole gets the last-admin protection.

platform_admin.label: Platform admin
platform_admin.description: Runs the platform: creates organizations and can open any of them.

org_admin.label: Organization admin
org_admin.description: Manages entities, users and settings for one organization.

finance.label: Finance
finance.description: Sees every entity, runs syncs, cannot manage users or settings.

member.label: Member
member.description: Sees only the entities assigned to them.

navigation.$comment: Sidebar items inside an organization, in order. Set enabled=false to hide a module everywhere. permission decides who sees it.

entityStatuses.$comment: tone: good | warning | critical | neutral. attention=true counts the entity under 'Needs attention'. includeInFigures=false leaves it out of totals.

overview.$comment: months: trailing window for overview figures and chart. topEntities: rows in the entity table (null = every entity). recentRuns: rows in the recent-sync list.

sync.$comment: Sample-entity sync simulation. Live entities (linked to a connected QuickBooks company) run the real sync.

messages.needs_reconnect: QuickBooks authorization expired. Reconnect the entity to resume syncing.
messages.error: QuickBooks returned an error for the ProfitAndLoss report. Retrying next run.

reports.$comment: The Reports page embeds the existing P&L dashboard unchanged. It is shown only for organizations with liveDashboard=true in the seed, because it holds that organization's real data. devUrl is used when the web app runs under Vite.

embed.placeholderTitle: Reports are not connected for this organization yet
embed.placeholderBody: Once its entities are connected to QuickBooks and synced, the P&L dashboard, office comparison and chart of accounts appear here.

sampleData.$comment: seedOnStartup loads the seed file into an empty platform database. Sample entities show generated figures with a 'Sample data' badge.
